teams.heading: Fiji concede 145 points across opening three matches of Nations Championship campaign
teams.body: The Flying Fijians currently hold the bottom position in the Nations Championship table after failing to secure a victory in their first three fixtures. The side has conceded 145 points following their 17-33 defeat against Scotland in Round 3, resulting in a point difference of -96. Fiji have managed 49 points of their own during the tournament thus far and must now look to address these defensive concerns ahead of their next scheduled fixture against France.

teams.heading: Chris Ashton admits deep regret regarding his England international playing career
teams.body: Former England wing Chris Ashton has revealed he remains frustrated by his international career, stating he never achieved the success he desired in the white jersey. Despite becoming the all-time leading try-scorer in Premiership history and earning 44 caps, the 39-year-old admits, "I'm still p*ssed off about England." Ashton, who scored 20 Test tries, claims he never felt he was given the proper opportunity to demonstrate his full understanding of the game while playing at the international level.

lead.why: The record-holding former England wing's candid reflection on his international career is the most discussed personal narrative in the press today.

teams.heading: Ireland Women’s Aoife Wafer ruled out of Japan Test after injury
teams.body: Ireland back row Aoife Wafer has been ruled out of Sunday’s WXV Global Series encounter against Japan in Galway due to a minor injury sustained in training. Head coach Scott Bemand has responded to last weekend’s 40-36 defeat by the USA with 6 changes to his starting side, including Eilís Cahill’s first start in the front row. Bemand noted that the upcoming matches provide an "ideal opportunity" to refine the team's attacking prowess before facing South Africa.

teams.heading: Uruguayan Flanker Lucas Bianchi Joins Italian Side Viadana For Season
teams.body: Uruguayan international Lucas Bianchi has completed a move to Italy to join Viadana in the Serie A Elite competition. The 25-year-old flanker, who represented Uruguay at the 2023 Rugby World Cup, arrives from the Super Rugby Americas circuit. His move adds to the growing contingent of South American talent securing contracts in the Italian league as the buildup toward the 2027 Rugby World Cup in Australia intensifies.

teams.heading: Darcy Graham Ruled Out As Scotland Confirms Men’s Autumn Test Absence
teams.body: Scotland have suffered a major setback with record try-scorer Darcy Graham ruled out of the upcoming autumn Tests following a ruptured bicep. The 29-year-old winger sustained the injury during a recent friendly match and is expected to be sidelined for at least 12 weeks. Edinburgh head coach Sean Everitt confirmed the news, stating, “That’s not good news for us and not good news for him.” Graham will miss home encounters against New Zealand, Australia, and Japan.

teams.heading: Wales Women recall Lleucu George and Carys Cox against United States
teams.body: Wales Women look to secure back-to-back victories as they face the United States at Cardiff Arms Park. Following a 50-19 win over South Africa, head coach Sean Lynn has recalled Lleucu George to the starting line-up at fly-half, with Keira Bevan shifting to scrum-half in place of the injured Seren Lockwood. Carys Cox also returns on the wing after recovering from knee surgery, while Georgia Evans is set to earn her 50th international cap for the side.

teams.body: Santiago Carreras has returned to club duty with Bath for the opening round of the Premiership season. teams.heading: Les Kiss moves Joseph-Aukuso Suaalii to the wing against Springboks
teams.body: Les Kiss has shifted Joseph-Aukuso Suaalii from outside centre to the left wing for Sunday’s Test against the Springboks, a decision designed to utilise the 23-year-old’s aerial skills against the world champions. While Suaalii has started all 24 of his previous Wallabies matches in the midfield, his coach expects the positional change to be smooth given his past experience at full-back. The selection coincides with the restoration of the long-standing midfield partnership between Hunter Paisami and Len Ikitau.

teams.heading: New Zealand Rugby considers exiting Super Rugby at major board summit
teams.body: New Zealand Rugby is reportedly set to evaluate its long-term future in Super Rugby Pacific during an upcoming board summit. Amid significant financial pressure and a target to save 53 million dollars, officials are weighing whether to maintain current competition structures or pursue an independent path. While the immediate future of the competition remains stable, the proposed summit highlights the ongoing internal review of New Zealand's professional rugby landscape and the sustainability of its existing international commitments.

teams.heading: Sir Steve Hansen insists rotated Springboks side remains dangerous in Perth
teams.body: Former All Blacks head coach Sir Steve Hansen has dismissed suggestions that South Africa are fielding a second-string team against Australia. With 13 changes to the starting XV for Sunday’s one-off Test, Hansen believes the Springboks’ immense depth ensures they remain highly competitive. While acknowledging the group might lack some cohesion, he noted that they have been training against the primary squad for some time, predicting the visitors will arrive as a "well-oiled" unit regardless of the personnel changes.

lead.why: It addresses the widespread narrative surrounding Rassie Erasmus' significant rotation for the upcoming Wallabies fixture.
